description: Lifecycle of an agent or critical skill in this repository. A markdown file existing is not a production agent.

states.name: draft
states.meaning: Role contract sketched. Not loaded by default consumers.

states.name: evaluation
exit_criteria: evaluation suite exists with at least one adversarial case
LLM-judged cases scored at or above the suite threshold

states.name: security-review
states.meaning: Reviewed by security for permissions, data access and escalation paths.
exit_criteria: tool list justified against least privilege
no path to production mutation without approval

states.name: pilot
states.meaning: In use on a limited set of projects with findings collected.
exit_criteria: used on at least two real changes

states.name: approved
states.meaning: Governance has accepted it for general use.
exit_criteria: AI governance approval recorded in the merge request

states.name: production
states.meaning: Default organizational role. Changes require the full change path.

states.name: deprecated
states.meaning: Superseded. Kept for one minor release with a migration note.

change_path_for_production_agents: static validation (scripts/validate_plugin.py, schema validation, secret scan)
evaluation suite for the changed agent plus governance suite
